title.full: Whether the Will Learning tool is binding

summary.text: No. The Will Learning tool is only for learning. Nothing entered there is final or legally binding.

details.heading: What the tool does
details.body: It helps you understand will-writing concepts. The Will Preparation Template can be revisited and amended at any time, even after you finish the exercise.

sources.page_title: Can I use the Will Learning tool to write a legally binding Will?

quotes.text: No, nothing you enter in the learning tool is final or legally binding.

This is purely a learning tool to help you understand will-writing concepts. The Will Preparation Template you receive at the end can be revisited and amended at any time, even after completing the exercise.
